_comment: Fragment 97 — D-140: a required repair item named inside an Applied entry, left undone beside items that were done, and only surfaced by an independent read of the corpus a session later. Merged 2026-08-27.

nodes.label: A Named Repair Item Left Undone Beside Ones That Were Done
nodes.description: A handoff entry's required repair listed several concrete actions, most of which were completed and cited as evidence, and one of which named a specific document row by id and was never touched, so the entry's overall Applied resolution read as complete while one of its own named items quietly was not.
nodes.rationale: An entry closing most of what it lists reads as closing all of it, and nothing distinguishes a satisfied item from an unmentioned one once the evidence line only cites the satisfied ones. The gap was found not by re-auditing the entry but by an independent pass over the corpus it referenced, days later, for an unrelated purpose.
